svg.text: short-depth 2U rack chassis, motherboard with a folded row of module slots, host-attached. Generated from hw/board_psram.yaml by hw/kicad_gen.py. Blue: ring ribbons on In2.Cu; pink: core-rail islands on In3.Cu. Rear of the chassis at the bottom.

Memory, PCIe and management nets are unrouted. Longest lane per hop: FPGA -> A0 73 mm; A0 -> A1 83 mm; A1 -> A2 83 mm; A2 -> A3 83 mm; A3 -> A4 83 mm; A4 -> A5 183 mm; A5 -> A6 83 mm; A6 -> A7 83 mm; A7 -> H0 83 mm; H0 -> H1 83 mm; H1 -> FPGA 89 mm
